name: @epoch/mobile
description: Epoch Mobile Field Client (W018) — the typed field-shell architecture plus an in-memory reference host for the mobile field client (architecture.md §Clients: "mobile is optimized for field capture/review/approval"). Field sessions are tenant-scoped (W099 grammar via @epoch/tenancy); capture envelopes are versioned, content-addressed, replay-safe channels carrying photo/sensor/note references as W006-convention evidence references BY DIGEST (never embedded payloads); quantity/progress observations are shaped as W036 Observation-distinction records with the MANDATORY uncertainty state and unambiguous work-package linkage by opaque id (ambiguity is a typed rejection, never a guess); field review/approval surfaces are W003 typed proposals through the W022 action-gateway seam — the client holds no credentials, executes nothing, and receives gateway decision records (allow/deny/requires-approval); the offline queue stores typed, content-addressed, idempotent records (duplicate capture = sealed prior record) and sync admission replays through the kernel seams with provenance — never a second semantic store (lock rules 8/16). REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION discipline (the W020/W022/W029 precedent): no real native bundling, no new third-party runtime dependencies, zero wall-clock, zero randomness, instants caller-supplied.
